instruction: Fix `percentile` in `numstats/descriptive.py` so it validates the requested percentile and raises a `ValueError` when `p` is outside 0..100. `percentile([1, 2, 3], 101)` currently crashes with an `IndexError` instead of reporting the out-of-range value.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/numstats/descriptive.py b/numstats/descriptive.py
--- a/numstats/descriptive.py
+++ b/numstats/descriptive.py
@@ -54,6 +54,8 @@
     """Return the p-th percentile of ``data`` (0 <= p <= 100) with linear interpolation."""
     if len(data) == 0:
         raise ValueError("percentile of empty sequence")
+    if not (0.0 <= p <= 100.0):
+        raise ValueError("p must be between 0 and 100")
     ordered = sorted(data)
     if len(ordered) == 1:
         return ordered[0]
